lines.text: It’s project time! Build an interactive poster about a topic you care about: at least three sprites that react to clicks with facts, motion, sound or effects, linked by a broadcast, and reset on the green flag.
Make an interactive poster about a topic you care about — a sport, an animal, a place, a cause.
For each sprite, decide its event (click or key) and its reaction (fact, sound, animation).
Use a broadcast so one click can start several reactions — like a title that makes everything dance.
Ask a classmate to explore your poster without help.
Great work! Let’s remember what we learned.
Now plan it, build it, test it, and share it!
